name: Milpitas Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn about police work through hands-on training, meetings twice a month, community events and ride-alongs with officers.
who_can_apply: The city page says ages 14 to 20 in one place and 16 to 20 in another, so ask. You need at least a 2.0 GPA, no major criminal convictions, and no substance abuse. You do not have to live in Milpitas.
duration: Ongoing, with meetings twice a month.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the Police Explorer Application, Personal History Statement and Medical Background Form from the page, or pick up an application at the police department, 1275 N Milpitas Blvd. You must pass an oral interview and a background check. Questions: 408-586-2400.
notes: The information sheet on the page is dated 2010 and still lists the Boy Scouts of America as co-sponsor, so call 408-586-2400 to check that the program is taking new members.
